About:

Meet Jupiter | Apply Here

Jupiter is a 3-year-old Poodle weighing 15 lbs. With his soft brown curls, this handsome boy is ready to start his next chapter. He can't wait to find his forever home in NYC!You don’t have to wait for an adoption event. In-person meet-and-greets are available in the NYC area, with virtual meet-and-greets available for adopters outside NYC.

Meet Us at Our Next Adoption Event

Where: Bartel-Pritchard Square - Prospect Park Southwest, Brooklyn, NY 11215

When: Sat Oct 10th

Time: 12-4pm
